title: Nine Weeks and a New Door
subtitle: 适应与改编 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 适应与改编（生活与自我·变化与调适）
meta: 主题语境：适应与改编（生活与自我·变化与调适）　|　核心词汇：adaptation　|　正文 326 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 adaptation 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1974 my mother made ① an adaptation of a room that had been a shop, and my grandmother said adaptation is what people call surrender. The ② adaptation, meaning the changes and not the room, took nine weeks and cost more than the shop; an adaptation, she said, is a change you agree to because the other one was worse. She said the other one was moving.

Every ③ adaptation in that house had been somebody's defeat first, and she said that was the honest order of things. Their ④ adaptation with the new door was nine inches out and nobody noticed; an adaptation, my father said, is the only work that is finished when nobody can see it. He said nine inches is exactly the right amount.

My brother meant the other thing: he read ⑤ the adaptation of a novel in 1976, nine chapters, and said it was better than the book. The ⑥ adaptation, meaning the book made into something else and not the change in a house, is the only art form that is judged by how much it betrays; an adaptation, my mother said, is either a way of surviving or a way of borrowing, and the word serves both. She said the borrowing is the part people argue about.

By 1979 the  adaptation had been finished twice and lived in once. The ⑦ adaptation of the play, she told me in March, had cut nine scenes and kept the wrong one; an adaptation, my father said, is what you call it when you keep the name and change the thing. He said that is also what people do to each other.

The  adaptation I remember is the shop with the new door, which my grandmother never entered. An ⑧ adaptation, she said in 1983, is the only thing a person does that proves they intended to stay; every adaptation, she said, is a small surrender with a good reason. She said she had never made one herself.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 改造；改建（一次具体的改动）
B. n. 改造（指那些改动，与屋子本身相对）
C. n. 改造（指换了新门的那一次）
D. 固定搭配：make an adaptation of 对……进行改造／改编
E. n. 改编本；改编作品（小说、戏剧的改编）
F. n. 改编（指“改编成另一种形式”这件事）
G. n. 改编（指剧本那一次）
H. n. 适应；改造（抽象总称；泛指）

items.q: The adaptation, meaning the changes and not the room
Their adaptation with the new door
The adaptation, meaning the book made into something else

answers.why: make an adaptation of 意为“对……进行改造”，1974 年母亲把一间原来是商店的屋子改造了，祖母说所谓适应／改造不过是人们给投降起的另一个名字。
adaptation 指“那些改动”，与屋子本身相对，这次改造花了九个星期，比那间店还贵。
adaptation 意为“一次具体的改造”，那屋里每一次改造都先是某人的一次失败，她说这才是事情本来的顺序。
adaptation 指换了新门的那一次，他们那次改造差了九英寸，谁也没看出来。
adaptation 意为“改编本、改编作品”，1976 年弟弟读了一部小说的改编本，共九章，说它比原书好。
adaptation 指“改编成另一种形式”这件事，与屋子里的改动相对，它是唯一一种以背叛多少来评判的艺术形式。
adaptation 指剧本那一次改编，她三月告诉我，那次剧本改编删了九场戏，留下的偏偏是错的那一场。
adaptation 为抽象总称，泛指“适应、改造这种事”，她说改造是一个人做出来、证明自己打算留下来的唯一一件事。
